nodes.name: ImportConfirmed.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the CAS import success screen: a centered success card with a positive-color badge, title, result text, and an action button, with a fade-in entrance animation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses design-token custom properties (--space, --color, --radius, --shadow, --type, --motion) from the Unifolio design system rather than hardcoded values, keeping the style consistent with Design-Schema-Unifolio.md.

nodes.name: ImportError.module.css
nodes.summary: Minimal CSS module providing the centered container layout for the CAS import error screen.

nodes.name: ParsingIndicator.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the CAS parsing progress indicator: an animated SVG arc loader, step text, and progress dots, with a reduced-motion media query to disable the spin animation.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a prefers-reduced-motion media query that disables the loader's spin keyframe animation for accessibility.

nodes.name: ReviewTable.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the CAS import review table: investor info summary grid, warning banner, an editable scheme-matching table, and the confirm button with disabled/hover states.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a responsive grid-template-columns media query to collapse the investor info grid from 6 to 2 columns on narrow viewports, and tabular-nums font-variant for aligned numeric data.

nodes.name: UploadForm.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module styling the CAS file upload form: drag-and-drop zone with hover/active states, selected-file badge, password-protected-PDF input with toggle button, and error/validation styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses color-mix() for tinted accent backgrounds on drag-over and selected-file states, layered on the shared design-token custom properties.
